dates: (1825/6-27 April 1913)
---

sister of the Rt.

Rev. J. C.

Patteson

She was daughter of Sir John Patteson by his second marriage to Frances Coleridge, and thus related to CMY.

She died at 74 Via della Croce, Rome, and probate was granted to Arthur John Coleridge Mackarness; she left £16,044 [census, will]
